hypotheses.falsifiable_from: Phase A export alone (descriptive, no edge claim)
hypotheses.statement: S1/S3 cost rejections are deep, not marginal: fewer than 25% of cost-rejected S1/S3 candidates have (projected reward minus round-trip cost) within 5 bps of the floor (i.e., gap > -5 bps for <25% of rejects).
hypotheses.what_rejection_means: If >=25% cluster near the floor, the threshold is marginal for a material share and floor calibration (not setup quality) is the next family to test in Phase B counterfactuals.

hypotheses.counterfactual_rule: Rejected-candidate sims are COUNTERFACTUAL DIAGNOSTICS, never strategy trades; insufficient-path outcomes are unscorable (no favorable intrabar picks).
hypotheses.falsifiable_from: Phase B executable-outcome measurement on development/validation only
hypotheses.null: The cost floor correctly rejects: counterfactually simulated cost-rejected S1/S3 candidates over intended 30-300s holds show mean net markout (executable arrival book, IOC band, liquidity, exit ordering, full itemized costs) <= 0.
hypotheses.rejection_rule: Reject the null (floor may be over-strict) only on statistically significant positive mean net markout with full section-81 metrics + adverse sensitivity; then ONE locked evaluation on untouched data decides.
hypotheses.statement: Phase B null hypothesis for counterfactual diagnostics.

selection_rule: Phase B selects ONE (strategy x variant) on development/validation only; compares vs CASH + unchanged baseline; records all attempts + selection bias. Promotion floor: 100 closed out-of-sample positions / 10 days minimum screen, not a guarantee; absent data -> DATA BLOCKED. Negative end = rejected hypothesis + measured reason, never relaxed gates.
